A '''baked golden apple''' is the simple preparation of the [[Golden Apple|golden apple]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Absorption}} for {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|duration|effect=Absorption}} and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_golden_apple.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden apple cooks into a baked golden apple in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked golden apple takes {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|heals}} and gives Absorption {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|level|effect=Absorption}} for {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|duration|effect=Absorption|format=clock}} and Regeneration {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Baked Golden Apple|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. The tooltip says Regeneration lasts 0:30, but the effect is 1200 ticks (1:00).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_golden_apple.json}}</ref>

Baked golden apples make [[Canned Golden Apples|canned golden apples]], the [[Gilded Empanada|gilded empanada]] and the [[Prayer of Man]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/warding.json}}</ref> Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
